texts.label: text
texts.orig: CERAWeek by IHS Markit is the premier annual international gathering of energy industry leaders, experts, government officials and policymakers, leaders from the technology, financial and industrial communities - and energy technology innovators. Chaired by Daniel Yergin, CERAWeek 2020 will be the event's 39th installment.
